description: Search tokens and pairs, inspect every pool of a token, monitor pairs, or pull promotion feeds, narratives and paid orders from DexScreener's public API.

allPools.description: When on, byToken returns every pool of each token on the chain. When off, it returns the best pair per token.
allPools.title: All pools per token

chainId.description: Blockchain to read. Required for byToken when not 'all', for bare pair addresses, and for orders. Also filters search and promotion feeds locally.
chainId.title: Chain

chainSearchTokens.description: How many matching tokens get their pools fetched when widening a chain search. 0 = quote variants only.
chainSearchTokens.title: Tokens to widen

customChainId.description: Optional override for a chain added after this release, e.g. 'newchain'. When set it replaces Chain.
customChainId.title: Custom chain id

dexIds.description: Keep only these DEX protocols, e.g. uniswap, raydium, aerodrome. Empty means all.
dexIds.title: DEX filter

expandChainSearch.description: When a chain is selected, also search quote variants and pull the token pools to get past the 30-pair search cap.
expandChainSearch.title: Widen search by chain

feed.description: Which live promotion feed to read. (mode=discovery)
feed.title: Promotion feed

includeFlags.description: Add heuristic flags such as low liquidity, new pair, sell pressure, or no socials.
includeFlags.title: Include risk flags

includeInfo.description: Add logo, header image, website and social links when DexScreener has them.
includeInfo.title: Include token info

includeMarketData.description: For promotion feeds, attach price, liquidity, volume, market cap and age of each token's best pair.
includeMarketData.title: Include market data

maxAgeHours.description: Skip pairs older than this many hours. Use 24 to keep pairs launched today.
maxAgeHours.title: Max pair age (hours)

maxFdvUsd.description: Skip pairs with a fully diluted valuation above this USD value.
maxFdvUsd.title: Max FDV (USD)

maxItems.description: Hard cap on records for the whole run.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxItemsPerQuery.description: Maximum records from each query, token, or feed. DexScreener caps search at 30.
maxItemsPerQuery.title: Max per query

maxLiquidityUsd.description: Skip pairs with liquidity above this USD value.
maxLiquidityUsd.title: Max liquidity (USD)

maxMarketCapUsd.description: Skip pairs above this market cap. Uses FDV when market cap is missing.
maxMarketCapUsd.title: Max market cap (USD)

maxPriceChange24h.description: Skip pairs whose 24-hour price change is above this percent. Negative values allowed.
maxPriceChange24h.title: Max 24h change (%)

maxTxns24h.description: Skip pairs with more buys plus sells in the last 24 hours.
maxTxns24h.title: Max 24h transactions

maxVolume24hUsd.description: Skip pairs with 24-hour volume above this USD value.
maxVolume24hUsd.title: Max 24h volume (USD)

metaSlugs.description: Narrative slugs such as ai, dog, cat, or x402. Run mode=metas to discover live slugs. (mode=metaPairs)
metaSlugs.title: Narrative slugs

minAgeHours.description: Skip pairs younger than this many hours.
minAgeHours.title: Min pair age (hours)

minFdvUsd.description: Skip pairs with a fully diluted valuation below this USD value.
minFdvUsd.title: Min FDV (USD)

minLiquidityUsd.description: Skip pairs with liquidity below this USD value.
minLiquidityUsd.title: Min liquidity (USD)

minMarketCapUsd.description: Skip pairs below this market cap. Uses FDV when market cap is missing.
minMarketCapUsd.title: Min market cap (USD)

minPriceChange24h.description: Skip pairs whose 24-hour price change is below this percent. Negative values allowed.
minPriceChange24h.title: Min 24h change (%)

minTxns24h.description: Skip pairs with fewer buys plus sells in the last 24 hours.
minTxns24h.title: Min 24h transactions

minVolume24hUsd.description: Skip pairs with 24-hour volume below this USD value.
minVolume24hUsd.title: Min 24h volume (USD)

mode.description: What to collect. Each mode uses its own fields below.
enumTitles: Pair lookup by address or URL
mode.title: Mode

newPairHours.description: Pairs younger than this many hours get a new_pair flag.
newPairHours.title: New pair threshold

onePairPerToken.description: Keep only the most liquid pair for each token.
onePairPerToken.title: One pair per token

pairAddresses.description: Pair URLs, chain:pairAddress, or bare pair addresses. Bare addresses need a specific chain. (mode=byPair)
pairAddresses.title: Pair addresses or URLs

queries.description: Token names, symbols, pair text such as SOL/USDC, token addresses, or DexScreener URLs. Multiple queries fan out. (mode=search)
queries.title: Search queries

quoteSymbols.description: Keep only pairs quoted in these assets, e.g. USDC, SOL, WETH. Empty means all.
quoteSymbols.title: Quote symbols

sortBy.description: Sort results within each query, token, or feed. Missing values are always last.
sortBy.title: Sort by

sortOrder.description: Largest/oldest first or smallest/newest first. Pair age ascending means newest first.
sortOrder.title: Sort order

tokenAddresses.description: One or more token contract addresses or DexScreener token URLs, separated by commas or new lines. (mode=byToken, orders)
tokenAddresses.title: Token addresses

title: DexScreener Scraper Input
